simple.meaning: בֶּדֶק (bedeq) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a gap or leak (in a building or a ship).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Kings 12:6. The surrounding context includes altar, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֶּדֶק (H919) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

firstOccurrence.englishText: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

timeline.evidenceText: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.
But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why don’t you repair the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”
The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.
The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into Yahweh’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house into it.
But there were not made for Yahweh’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house;
Let them deliver it into the hand of the workmen who have the oversight of Yahweh’s house; and let them give it to the workmen who are in Yahweh’s house, to repair the damage to the house,

definitions.full: H919. bedeq בֶּ֫דֶק noun masculine 2Kin 12:6 fissure, rent, breach (Aramaic בִּידְקָא , (Nasar.)) — ׳בּ absolute 12:6 ; construct ib. 6t.; suffix בִּדְקֵךְ Ezek 27:9 , 27 ; — in as building; temple ׳ב הַבַּיִת 2Kin 12:6 ; 12:7 ; 12:8 (twice in verse); 12:9 ; 22:5 , compare 12:13 ( ׳ב י ׳בֵּית ); v. 12:6 absolute; always with חִזֵּק repair ; compare ׳ב מַחֲזִיקֵי repairers of thy fissures Ezek 27:9 , 27 (of Tyre).
